confidence_levels.canon_confirmed: Stated by the official UnstableSMP site or by multiple independent sources (wiki + episode evidence / TV Tropes).
confidence_levels.supported: Stated by the community wiki (unstable-universe-mc.fandom.com) in at least one page; not independently re-verified.
confidence_levels.uncertain: Partial, inferred, or contradicted between sources. Treat as unverified.

_schema.research_method: Direct fetching of the wiki and unstablesmp.gg was blocked by the build environment's network policy. Research was performed through search-engine snippets of those pages (wiki article summaries, TV Tropes recaps, official site metadata). Statements are therefore attributed to pages, with confidence downgraded where only a snippet was available. See docs/LORE_RESEARCH.md.
_schema.gameplay_role_note: potential_gameplay_role and any 'GAME MECHANIC' text is a design interpretation, never canon.

entries.name: ParrotX2
entries.role: Protagonist (one of four POV characters)
faction: Warriors Council / Far Lands Civilization (former leader)
entries.first_appearance: Season 1 (series premiere era, 2024) — exact episode not verified
important_events: Met Theo in 'Unstable SMP: The First War' at the Far Lands Civilization; Theo helped him become leader of the Warriors District and end its dispute with the Farming District.
Won leadership of the Warriors Council after Purpled was outvoted; TheobaldTheBird had beaten him in a mission-leader contest using TNT minecarts.
The Invisible Mafia destroyed the Far Lands Civilization; Parrot founded District 13 (Theo left over lack of progress, later saved Parrot from two withers at spawn and rejoined).
Treasure Arc: took an End portal to spawn, was saved from withers by Theo, ran a shop in Capital City 2.0 (Reddoons) that became a smuggling business; trapped Wemmbu and Flame in an inescapable cell.

Kings Arc: refused LettuceK's bribe during the election; brought to Capital City to be executed; Deputy_Ace saved him and Theo; Spepticle was executed in his place; District 13 defeated LettuceK's Law; Parrot restarted the election and won, becoming the first King of the Unstable SMP.
Promised to resign if new players could not spawn safely within 100 Minecraft days; rushed policies destabilised the kingdom.
Founded the Skymore Civilization for 1,000 new players; ShoeBilly and Cindercrest killed 999 of them (survivors: Zoe and Reina).
Built Fort Feather to train an army; Cindercrest took it with a redstone blimp paratrooper assault; Parrot partially self-destructed the fort with TNT.
Battle for Capital City: Saparata persuaded the Royal Army to defect; Parrot dueled Saparata and lost; dethroned and exiled, whereabouts of Theo and Reina unknown.
known_equipment: Wolves (used to unmask Wemmbu as the Invisible Knight)
known_abilities: Political manoeuvring (elections, alliances, hostage negotiation at Merchant City)

important_relationships.type: tritagonist of his Kingdoms Saga POV; Skymore survivor he protected
arch-enemy; Saparata blames Parrot for the deaths of his friends
election rival; tried to execute him
Wemmbu holds a vendetta after Parrot unmasked and got him captured by the Law
The Owl; executed in Parrot's place
saved Parrot and Theo from execution, died for it

entries.potential_gameplay_role: HERO — leadership/strategy. Buff auras, economy, temporary Royal Army summons. GAME MECHANIC: abilities are inspired by his kingship and army-building, not literal canon powers.

entries.name: Wemmbu
entries.role: Protagonist (one of four POV characters)
faction: Arachn1d's Kingdom / Spider Web Faction (second-in-command, unwillingly)
important_events: Early strong alliance with PrinceZam; Zam's paranoia led to betrayal and the griefing of Wemmbu's Civilization, which then declared independence.
Detonated an Orbital Strike Cannon against Zam; ClownPierce imprisoned the two together for entertainment, forcing them to cooperate.

Received his first mace from Yeah_Jaron to defend the Skyblock Civilization from an Invisible Mafia raid; the mace passed through FlameFrags, ClownPierce and FerreMC before Wemmbu won it back by defeating FerreMC.
Faked his death and posed as the Invisible Knight; Parrot (hired by Flame) unmasked him with wolves, leading to his capture by the Law.
Pirate Arc: Jaden_MAN held Eggchan hostage; Wemmbu nearly died at Jaden's castle before it exploded; Theo revealed he had been secretly helping.
Power Arc: fought FlameFrags using cannons and mace, made Flame run, declared himself the strongest player of Unstable.

Kingdoms Saga: Arachn1d and yungyx took Eggchan captive in stasis chambers to force Wemmbu into the Kingdom of the Caves; accidentally released wardens in the mines; forced to duel Jaden; sent to Steampunk City to beat Cindercrest's representative; fought ShoeBilly, trapping him in webs and breaking his helmet with stab shots.
Arachn1d betrayed him, dropping him into a pit of players with only a Golden Apple and a Totem of Undying.
Battle for Capital City: betrayed Cindercrest and annihilated thousands of soldiers with Orbital Strike Cannons; a nuke shot killed hundreds of innocent players.
With yungyx, dethroned Arachn1d (killed by yungyx).
known_equipment: Mace 'Gambit' (Density V, Mending, Unbreaking III, Fire Aspect II, Wind Burst II) — his signature weapon
Orbital Strike Cannons (nuke shots and stab shots)
Totem of Undying and Golden Apple (the pit)

important_relationships.type: best friend, teammate, one of the few people he trusts
former close ally turned betrayer; partially reconciled while imprisoned, never truly allies again
antagonist and ally, switching several times; tritagonist of Wemmbu's Kingdoms POV
captor and betrayer; main antagonist of his Kingdoms POV
vendetta after being unmasked and captured

entries.potential_gameplay_role: HERO — aggressive melee damage dealer with clutch survival. GAME MECHANIC: Stab Shot / Nuke Shot abilities are inspired by his Orbital Strike Cannon use; Totem clutch inspired by the pit betrayal.

entries.name: FlameFrags
entries.role: Protagonist (fourth POV, joined in Season 2)
faction: Cindercrest (reluctantly joined in Season 3 to protect Lomedy)
important_events: Toxic War Arc: hunted by a toxic civilization (the wiki summary says the attacking group was led by SpokeIsHere); found Lomedy's farm and forcibly moved in; won only because Lomedy gave him his old teammate's mace; Lomedy built TNT cannons while Flame killed the attackers and beat the leader 1v1; gave Lomedy both maces.
Farm War: fought with netherite armor and no weapons allowed.
Skill vs Power Arc: recruited by Lomedy against Spongs and Willsion; an invisible player revealed as SpokeIsHere gave him a book with coordinates to an old Mafia stash.
Hired Parrot to find Wemmbu, who had faked his death.
The Law hunted him and imprisoned Lomedy as leverage; Flame broke in but Lomedy refused to leave; after the Law fell Flame apologised, admitted Lomedy was right, and returned the mace.
Trained in TNT minecart combat with Theo ('I Got Trained By a Minecraft TNT Master').
Power Arc: lost a fight to Wemmbu's cannons and mace and retreated.
Kingdoms Saga: Lomedy wanted to join Cindercrest; Flame joined reluctantly to protect him; Saparata instructed him to obtain Wemmbu's orbital cannons.
known_equipment: Mace (Lomedy's old teammate's mace, later returned)

important_relationships.type: closest ally; farmer who armed him and whom he wronged and apologised to
antagonist and ally at different times

entries.potential_gameplay_role: HERO — duelist: single-target burst, survivability. GAME MECHANIC: 'Duel Challenge' and 'Mace Drop' are inspired by his 1v1 victories and Lomedy's mace.

entries.name: SpokeIsHere
entries.role: Protagonist (one of four POV characters)
important_events: Ashswagg manipulated Spoke into destroying farms so the server would turn against him and away from Mapicc.
Attacked by the Mafia with Mapicc; saved by MinuteTech, who only agreed to work with them after they proved themselves.
Infiltrated the Invisible Mafia; Ash promoted Leo and Mapicc but held Spoke back; sent to kill the innocent IMajesticRose; a 'diamond' player revealed as Minute let them escape.
Suspected Roshambogames of duping and found him at a flower farm; realised Roshambo was harmless when invisible players blew it up — proof that Ash had betrayed them.
Given the chance to kill Ash, chose not to, refusing to prove Ash's claim that they were alike.
BAT Arc: raised an army of 1,000 players and founded the Spoke Galactic Empire, forcibly recruiting the builder Horace Altman and surviving assassination attempts.
Purgatory Arc: forced JamatoP to surrender, took his armor and the Totem of NULL, and became leader of the NULL, reorganising it from bounty hunters into a full army.
Wind-charged his friend Mapicc into the void.
known_equipment: Invisibility (operated as an invisible player when contacting Flame)

important_relationships.type: best friend / deuteragonist; later launched into the void
manipulator and nemesis; Spoke spared him
ally / double agent inside the Mafia

entries.potential_gameplay_role: HERO — manipulation, traps, control. GAME MECHANIC: 'Turncoat', 'Wind Charge Trap' and 'Nullify' are inspired by his infiltration, wind charge use and NULL leadership.

entries.name: Saparata
entries.role: Major antagonist; leader of Cindercrest; current King of Unstable
entries.first_appearance: Season 3 Kingdoms Saga (2026) — earlier appearances not verified
major_arcs: Kingdoms Saga (main antagonist of Parrot's POV)
important_events: Leads Cindercrest, a faction of veteran warriors that kills new players or forces them to work for it, arguing the old players are 'starving' because of them.
Blames Parrot for the deaths of his friends and the disorder of the server; seeks revenge.
Allied with Arachn1d's Kingdom of the Caves for the Civil War against Parrot's Kingdom.
Cindercrest destroyed Skymore (ShoeBilly killed 999 of 1,000 settlers).
Assault on Fort Feather using a Redstone Blimp with slow-falling paratroopers.
With ShoeBilly, kidnapped Reina near the end of the war.
Battle for Capital City: persuaded Parrot's Royal Army to defect; dueled and defeated King Parrot; Cindercrest seized Capital City and Spawn; crowned himself King.
Revealed he planned to kill every new player who joined after Parrot's coronation, and killed new players on sight at spawn; manipulated new players to his side and then killed them.
Sent an army with ShoeBilly to reclaim a stronghold captured by the NULL.
known_equipment: Full netherite gear (Cindercrest is described as able to equip thousands in netherite)
known_abilities: Elite PvP (defeated Parrot in a duel)

important_relationships.type: wartime ally; Arachnid intended to become King if Parrot fell

entries.potential_gameplay_role: BOSS — multi-phase Cindercrest encounter (vanguard, elite strike, blimp assault, duel, usurper king). GAME MECHANIC: 'Persuasion' converting a tower is inspired by the Royal Army defection.

entries.name: ShoeBilly_
entries.role: Antagonist; Cindercrest assassin and elite mace fighter
important_events: A renowned assassin who slowly killed all 1,000 Skymore settlers as they left on food expeditions (Zoe and Reina survived).
Battle of Merchant City: maced people until Cindercrest was forced to retreat.
Fought Wemmbu, who trapped him in webs and used stab shots to break his helmet; withdrew to recover after his armor broke.
Kidnapped Reina with Saparata; attacked Parrot and his commanders at Capital City alongside Wemmbu; led the army sent to reclaim a stronghold from the NULL.
known_equipment: Netherite armor (broken by Wemmbu's stab shots)
entries.potential_gameplay_role: MINI-BOSS — assassin that disables towers it passes; armor-break mechanic references his broken helmet. GAME MECHANIC.

entries.name: arachn1d_
entries.role: Antagonist; ruler of the Kingdom of the Caves; main antagonist of Wemmbu's Kingdoms POV
faction: Kingdom of the Caves / Arachnid's Kingdom (founder, ruler)

Stopped the forced duel between Wemmbu and Jaden; sent Wemmbu to Steampunk City to send a message to Saparata.
Betrayed Wemmbu by dropping him into a pit of players with only a Golden Apple and a Totem of Undying.
Dethroned by Wemmbu and yungyx; killed by yungyx.
known_equipment: Wardens in the mines (unleashed accidentally by Wemmbu)

important_relationships.type: wartime ally with his own claim to the throne

entries.potential_gameplay_role: BOSS (future Kingdom of the Caves map) — web traps, warden summons, hostage mechanics. GAME MECHANIC.

entries.name: Ashswagg
entries.role: Main antagonist of Season 1; leader of The Invisible Mafia
important_events: Manipulated Spoke into destroying farms to isolate him from Mapicc.
The Mafia destroyed the Far Lands Civilization, tore down Spawn to build a giant prison (designed by _Kenadian_) to force new players to join, and destroyed every reachable ominous spawner.
Told Spoke that Spoke was a lot like himself; Spoke later declined to kill him.
Season 1 ended with 'The End of the Minecraft Mafia'.
entries.potential_gameplay_role: BOSS (future Invisible Mafia map) — invisible waves, pearl teleport phases. GAME MECHANIC.

entries.role: Main antagonist of Season 2; corrupt leader of The Law during the Kings Arc
faction: The Law (leader during the Kings Arc)
Ice Mountain Civilization (former, with loppezz and Arcn)

Executed Spepticle in Parrot's place; brought Parrot and Theo to Capital City to be executed; ordered SargeLAW to kill Deputy_Ace for freeing them.
Built the Smuggler's Pass Outpost (fort and prison) and the LAW Desert Outpost.
The Law's final battle was lost to District 13; Lettuce surrendered; a vote decided his fate and Wemmbu chose to let him live.

entries.potential_gameplay_role: ELITE ENEMY / neutral faction leader; possible tower in Law-themed maps. GAME MECHANIC.

Trained FlameFrags in TNT minecart combat.
Wiped out many Cindercrest players with his signature carting during the Civil War; his whereabouts were unknown after the finale.
